title: Gullak
description:
What method you tend to use when you want to save some money together with your friends for your next trip to Goa? or maybe raising money together for your next million dollar startup? We are pretty sure you don't go about opening a joint bank account to save money with your siblings for your mom's next birthday.
Enter Gullak an simple application to make shared goal based wallets for you, your friends or the random dude you vibed in the bar.
Just login with your social media, get a wallet, add money with your credit cards, make a group for you and your friends and start saving money in the group as simple as that.
how_its_made: We were stuck for a very long time on Web3Auth and Biconomy to make the SCW.
